description: You are a backend engineer at a fintech startup. Your product manager Sarah is preparing for a compliance audit and needs to verify that the subscription pricing logic in 'src/pricing.py' correctly implements the business rules: (1) Enterprise customers get 20% discount, (2) Annual billing gets additional 15% discount, (3) Price never goes below $99/month minimum. The file is located at '/home/ga/workspace/pricing_service/src/pricing.py' and contains a function 'calculate_subscription_price'. Sarah is non-technical and gets overwhelmed by type hints and technical code. Add clear, business-focused inline comments (at least 4 meaningful comments) to the function that explain each discount rule in terms a non-technical person can understand. Use business language like 'customers', 'subscription', 'discount' rather than technical jargon. Make sure to explain: the 20% Enterprise customer discount, the 15% annual billing discount, and the $99 minimum price floor. Save the file when done.
